package poe

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/Vilsol/go-pob-data/loader"
	"github.com/Vilsol/go-pob-data/raw"
)

type Row struct {
	raw.Row
}

var Rows []*Row

var Others []*raw.Other

func InitializeRows(ctx context.Context, version string) error {
	return loader.InitHelper(ctx, version, "Rows", &Rows)
}

func (r *Row) GetHidden() int {
	return r.Hidden
}

func (r *Row) GetVia() string {
	return r.Via
}

func (r *Row) GetIface() string {
	return r.Iface
}

func (r *Row) GetOther() string {
	return Others[r.OtherKey].Name
}
